title: 001B EFFLUENT - RP1 RECYCLED WATER sampling results
license: Public state water-quality portal; terms not separately specified
scope: Public laboratory records for recycled-water effluent sampled from 2023-08-09 through 2026-07-28; the inventory contains 149 lab sample IDs and 1,177 analyte rows.
coverage_note: Observed chloride, calcium, magnesium, sodium, sulfate and total alkalinity rows recur across the portal; observed pH, temperature, TDS and silica rows are absent.
source_context: Direct recycled-water effluent; not a cooling-tower operating dataset and not an independent PHREEQC validation package.
